title: The link pattern cut destinations with parentheses and missed titles in parentheses and destinations on the next line
resolution: Links now come from the GFM lexer of marked 15.0.12, exact-pinned as a development dependency, with a regression test for each case.

title: Indented code, fences inside block quotes, and multi-line code spans were checked as text, and a fence closed despite trailing text
resolution: The lexer separates code blocks, code spans, and raw HTML from prose; a regression test covers each case and an invalid closing fence.

title: Heading anchors kept emphasis markers and raw entities and ignored Setext headings, unlike GitHub
resolution: Anchors are slugs of the lexer's rendered heading text with entities decoded, Setext headings included and the -1 numbering kept; a test covers them.

title: A fragment-only link in a spec delta skipped the rule that a delta links only root-relative
resolution: The spec delta rule now runs before a fragment-only link resolves to its own file, with a test.

title: The requirement excluded only three URI schemes and promised every link, while the code skipped any scheme and no reference-style link
resolution: Reference-style links are checked at each use; the requirement, proposal, and design now name inline and reference links and exclude any URI scheme, with tests.

title: The records said the changed files were outside the published package, though package.json is in the tarball
resolution: The proposal and verification record now say that runtime code and packaged documents are unchanged and the manifest gains a script and a development dependency.

title: Task 4.3 stayed open although the record showed a passing make verify
